mechanism.claim: A completed hour in which Deribit DVOL expands while Binance BVOL contracts, followed by a completed hour in which both expand, marks an options-led volatility discovery handoff to the broader venue. If BTC moves in the same nonzero direction in both hours, the twice-confirmed direction should relay for six hours.
mechanism.side: common sign of the two completed-hour BTC returns
mechanism.why_distinct: DBVHDR uses an ordered two-hour venue transition from Deribit-only expansion to joint expansion plus two-hour directional BTC confirmation. It is not contemporaneous BVOL/DVOL disagreement, a fixed four-hour ignition block, a high-volatility level gate, or intrahour absorption.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: the ordered cross-venue implied-volatility handoff and its two completed-hour confirmation geometry are absent from Gross9
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the clock activates on newly broadening implied-volatility expansion rather than on static calm-market levels

clock.decision: T after two consecutive completed source-valid UTC hours [T-2h,T-1h) and [T-1h,T)
clock.leader_hour: prior-hour normalized DVOL body > 0 and normalized BVOL body < 0
clock.handoff_hour: current-hour normalized DVOL body > 0 and normalized BVOL body > 0
clock.price_confirmation: BTC completed-hour returns in the leader and handoff hours have the same nonzero sign
clock.trigger: false-to-true onset with all required source hours consecutive
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT T+5m open, after all features are available
clock.side: common sign of the two completed-hour BTC returns
clock.reservation: global half-open; chronological signals; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; opened only for later exact PnL accounting

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

diagnostic_controls.no_ordered_handoff: current-hour joint expansion plus same-direction two-hour BTC confirmation
diagnostic_controls.leader_hour_only: prior-hour DVOL expansion/BVOL contraction plus prior-hour BTC direction
diagnostic_controls.handoff_hour_only: current-hour joint expansion plus current-hour BTC direction
diagnostic_controls.one_hour_stale_handoff: the frozen handoff state lagged by one completed hour

source_plan.volatility: hash-bound official Binance BTCBVOLUSDT and Deribit BTC DVOL completed-hour candles, including the sealed 2026-07 extension
source_plan.completed_price_features: hash-bound preentry BTC intrahour path snapshot; only completed-hour returns are opened for support
source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source-support and Gross9 novelty pass
